venture_under_test.name: LedgerJet
venture_under_test.description: LedgerJet is a B2B SaaS corporate card + spend-management platform for venture-backed startups and high-growth companies with 20-500 employees. We bundle corporate cards, AP automation, expense reimbursement, vendor payments, and accounting integrations into one product. Pricing: free corporate cards (interchange-funded) + $12 per employee per month for the spend-management dashboard. Target buyer: CFO, Controller, or Head of Finance at venture-backed Seed-to-Series-C startups. We compete with Brex, Ramp, Mercury, Airbase, and Navan (formerly TripActions). Differentiation: native QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite reconciliation in <30s (vs competitors' batch sync), card-issuance API for embedding into vertical SaaS workflows, and free wire transfers up to $50k/month included in the base tier.
